decisive_items: well‐circumscribed, oval, covered by regular skin, firm, gray‐white
encapsulated polyp was removed en bloc
response.rationale: Leiomyoma best fits the firm, fibrotic, well-circumscribed, encapsulated polypoid lesion covered by normal skin; hemangioma is contradicted by firmness and lack of vascular features, while fibroma is less specific for this anal location and presentation.

rejected.why: Firm fibrotic consistency and absence of bleeding or vascular features argue against hemangioma.
Fibroma is plausible but leiomyoma is more characteristic for a firm, encapsulated anal canal polyp with these gross features.
